## Lab pattern glance

Existing slot: `apps/app/src/components/design-system/lab-prototypes/`

- One folder per prototype: `ComponentName.tsx` + scoped `component-name.css` + `fixtures.ts` + `index.ts` + stories
- `'use client'`, named exports, CSS rooted under a class (e.g. `.sa-root`)
- `LabPrototypes_PSUEDOCODE.md` already lists **`DiagnosticArchitecture`** for item #2; Monolith / Cognitive Routing are not in that inventory yet
- App already has `three`, `gsap`, `lucide-react` — no new deps required for porting

---

## 1. Monolith Engine

| Field | Finding |
|--------|---------|
| **Component name** | `MonolithEngine` |
| **Suggested folder** | `lab-prototypes/monolith-engine/` |
| **Source size** | ~429 HTML lines |
| **Complexity** | **High** |

**External deps**
- Three.js **0.160** (ESM) + `EffectComposer`, `RenderPass`, `UnrealBloomPass`
- GSAP 3.12.2 + **ScrollTrigger**
- Tailwind CDN, Iconify (`solar:*`), Google Fonts (Space Grotesk)
- DESIGN also mentions JetBrains Mono for labels (not loaded in HTML)

**Structure / interactions**
- Loader overlay (shimmer bar) → fade out
- Full-viewport WebGL: vortex particles (~9.5k), spiral guides, ambient points, bloom
- Fixed chrome: corner marks, nav (Structure/Array/Logic), Link CTA
- Scroll overlay (~160vh): masked word reveal headline + Execute / Data Logs
- Footer: live mouse coords, scroll hint, icon links
- Mouse-parallax on scene; speed-based **glitch** on `.glitch-target` text

**Self-contained client + scoped CSS?**
- Yes, with caveats: needs canvas lifecycle (`useEffect` mount/cleanup), ResizeObserver, ScrollTrigger scoped to component root (not `window` page). Prefer scoped CSS (or Tailwind-in-app classes) over CDN Tailwind.

**Must replace**
| CDN / asset | Replace with |
|-------------|--------------|
| `cdn.tailwindcss.com` | Scoped CSS / app Tailwind |
| Iconify solar icons | Lucide (`ArrowRight`, `Play`, `FileText`, `Link`, `Maximize2`) |
| Google Fonts Space Grotesk | `next/font` or local font hook |
| unpkg Three + addons | `import * as THREE from 'three'` + `three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/...` |
| cdnjs GSAP/ScrollTrigger | `gsap` + `gsap/ScrollTrigger` |
| Full-window canvas sizing | Container-relative sizing for Storybook/gallery embed |

---

## 2. Diagnostic Architecture // Model Teardown

| Field | Finding |
|--------|---------|
| **Component name** | `DiagnosticArchitecture` (matches existing pseudocode) |
| **Suggested folder** | `lab-prototypes/diagnostic-architecture/` |
| **Source size** | ~366 HTML lines |
| **Complexity** | **Medium** |

**External deps**
- GSAP only (entrance timeline + idle yoyo drift)
- Tailwind CDN, Iconify
- **No Three.js in the HTML** despite DESIGN tags (`webgl`, `threejs`) — centerpiece is **inline SVG** exploded wireframe

**Structure / interactions**
- Halftone dither + technical grid + vignette background
- Header: Kernel.Diagnostic_v4.2, mode tabs (Topology / Wireframe / Metrics — UI only)
- Left: Active Nodes + Load Dist meters; Right: Telemetry Stream
- Center SVG: 4 exploded layers + struts + annotation callouts (Capacitor / Resonance / Housing / Manifold)
- Footer: playback controls, scrub timeline chrome, Engage Sys / Isolate
- GSAP: layer explode-in → strut draw → connector stroke-dash draw → annotation fade → continuous layer drift

**Self-contained client + scoped CSS?**
- Yes — best fit of the three. Pure DOM/SVG + GSAP timeline in `useEffect`. No WebGL. Nav/playback can stay presentational or light local state.

**Must replace**
| CDN / asset | Replace with |
|-------------|--------------|
| Tailwind CDN | Scoped CSS |
| Iconify (`server-square`, rewind/pause/forward, maximize) | Lucide |
| GSAP CDN | npm `gsap` |
| DESIGN “Inter” | Optional; HTML is system `font-sans` — JetBrains Mono already used for telemetry |
| SVG `id` collisions if multiple instances | Scope ids (`useId`) for patterns/groups |

**Note:** DESIGN overstates WebGL; port the SVG teardown, not a Three scene.

---

## 3. Cognitive Routing Framework

| Field | Finding |
|--------|---------|
| **Component name** | `CognitiveRoutingFramework` |
| **Suggested folder** | `lab-prototypes/cognitive-routing-framework/` |
| **Source size** | ~308 HTML lines |
| **Complexity** | **Medium-low** (UI med / WebGL low) |

**External deps**
- Three.js **r128** (global script — icosahedron + wireframe + MeshPhysicalMaterial)
- GSAP (opacity/y reveals only — no ScrollTrigger)
- Tailwind CDN, Iconify, Google Fonts (Inter + JetBrains Mono)
- Small inline CSS: flicker keyframes, `.poster-shell` gradient border, scrollbar

**Structure / interactions**
- Page frame: vertical guide lines + corner ticks
- Poster shell card (~85vh): header OP-CORE, status clock
- Hero: Three mesh behind “Cognitive Topology” copy + corner reticles
- 3 footer panels: Ingestion / Consensus / Heuristics (hover top-bar grow)
- Bottom meta: “AWAITING INSTRUCTION…” + secure tether
- GSAP stagger reveals; `setInterval` UTC clock on `#live-time`; slow globe spin/float

**Self-contained client + scoped CSS?**
- Yes. Contained poster layout ports cleanly; WebGL is a single mesh in a container. Scope flicker/poster-shell into CSS module/root class.

**Must replace**
| CDN / asset | Replace with |
|-------------|--------------|
| three.js r128 CDN | npm `three` (API nearly identical for this scene) |
| GSAP CDN | npm `gsap` |
| Iconify (cpu, sort, network, shield) | Lucide |
| Google Fonts Inter / JetBrains Mono | `next/font` or extend `use-symbolon-fonts` / local hook |
| Tailwind CDN | Scoped CSS |
| `mix-blend-screen` WebGL layer | Keep; verify against parent stacking in gallery |

---

## Port difficulty ranking

1. **`DiagnosticArchitecture`** — easiest; already planned; SVG + GSAP  
2. **`CognitiveRoutingFramework`** — moderate; simple Three + poster layout  
3. **`MonolithEngine`** — hardest; postprocessing bloom, ScrollTrigger, particle sim, glitch, full-bleed scroll chrome

## Shared replacement checklist (all three)

- Drop: Tailwind CDN, Iconify CDN, Google Fonts CDN, any script CDNs  
- Use: Lucide, npm `three` / `gsap`, scoped root CSS, `'use client'`  
- No image/video assets in any of the three sources
